t: Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2020 for the use of the Department of Defense for research, development, test, and evaluation, as specified in the funding table in section 4203.

fable.w: This section only authorizes appropriations for Department of Defense research, development, test, and evaluation. No party outside the federal government is consulted or given a role in any federal decision; there is no comment period, hearing, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue. There is no real tempting reading here, since the text is purely about funding.
fable.s: Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2020 for the use of the Department of Defense for research, development, test, and evaluation

qwen_block.w: This section is a standard appropriations clause authorizing the Department of Defense to spend funds on internal activities (research, development, test, and evaluation). It does not involve any consultation, coordination, or decision-making process with parties outside the federal government. There are no advisory boards, public comment periods, or requirements to consult with states, tribes, or the public.
qwen_block.s: Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2020 for the use of the Department of Defense for research, development, test, and evaluation, as specified in the funding table in section 4203.

opus.w: This section authorizes funding for DoD research, development, test, and evaluation and does nothing else. It sets up no way for anyone outside the federal government to take part in a federal decision. The fact that RDT&E may involve outside contractors is not participation, because the text creates no consultation, hearing, comment, or advisory process.
opus.b: This section only authorizes appropriations. The one reading that might pull toward "Yes" is that research, development, test, and evaluation could involve outside contractors or experts. That reading fails because the text sets up no consultation, hearing, comment period, advisory body, rulemaking, or right to sue. The only actors named are federal: the Department of Defense and a funding table.

qwen_chat.w: This section is a standard appropriation authorization for the Department of Defense. It does not contain any language requiring consultation, coordination, or input from parties outside the federal government (such as states, tribes, the public, or private entities) before a decision is made. The mention of research and development does not, in this context, mandate a participatory process with outsiders.
qwen_chat.s: Funds are hereby authorized to be appropriated for fiscal year 2020 for the use of the Department of Defense for research, development, test, and evaluation, as specified in the funding table in section 4203.
qwen_chat.b: Tempting-but-wrong reading: One might argue that "research, development, test, and evaluation" inherently involves contractors or experts outside the government, thus implying participation. However, the text itself is merely an authorization of appropriations and does not mandate any specific process of consultation, coordination, or public input. It is a funding provision, not a procedural one requiring outside involvement.
